text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I made too much again.

I spotted Durandal letting out a sigh.
In front of her was...
a mountain of croquettes piled high on a large plate.
choice_data_list: That's a crazy amount of croquettes...!
That's a crazy amount of croquettes...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-dono.
...I was craving a taste of home, so I made some food, but—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I misjudged the portion size.
Out of old habit, I ended up making far too much.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes, we are quite a large family, after all.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I served food on occasion,
it was routine to pile this much onto a large platter."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Dinner's ready, everyone.
Take as much as you'd like from the plates."

text_block_list.name: Durandal's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Wah, dumplings~!
Awesome, I'm gonna eat a ton of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Durandal's Eldest Brother
text_block_list.text:
Haha! With this many, there's no need to fight over 'em.
Thanks, Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I knew at least this much was necessary!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, it was normal for me
to cook for a large group of people all at once."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: However, there is no problem. Back when I first entered the academy, I used to make far too much like this all the time.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: If it's just this much, I can finish it all.
choice_data_list: Let's call someone over and eat together!
Let's soak in all the memories!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"That's a wonderful idea!
Let's enjoy it deliciously with everyone."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~! This is splendid!
I'll gladly accept this, then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Spoon some onto the plate, and...
Ehehe, I think I'll eat just a little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Croquette—Japanese—home cooking.
—I shall savor it.
choice_data_list: I'm glad everyone could make it.
I'm glad everyone came, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's so lively...
It feels like our dining table back then.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. This massive portion is
a form of memories with my family, too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I wish to savor every single bit of it.
Afterward, a nostalgic Durandal polished off a huge platter of croquettes completely!
